answer: Records stack in shale layers, one thin append per drop, and the courier device signs each layer inside a hardware enclave that releases the day's nectar only after three unrelated agencies confirm it. So a fake courier needs three genuine enclaves and three genuine routes for one payout, pushing the cost per identity above a week of honest work while the auditor pool, a reef of small independent agencies, rotates every epoch so no agency grades the same route twice.
